-- name: SearchCustomers
-- param: @status varchar(10) null
SELECT
    c.id,
    c.name,
    c.email,
    c.phone,
    c.status
FROM dbo.customers AS c
WHERE
    c.name LIKE @q
    AND (@status IS NULL OR c.status = @status)
ORDER BY
    c.name, c.id
    OFFSET @skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @take ROWS ONLY;
